title: Camp Pendleton Fire Department Combats the Ongoing “Henderson Fire”
description: Members of the Camp Pendleton Fire Department and partnering agencies discuss fire mitigation planning at an incident command post during operations to combat the “Henderson Fire” at Marine Corps Base Camp Pendleton, California, Oct. 18, 2026. The Camp Pendleton Fire Department, supported by air and ground units from CAL FIRE and other agencies, responded to the scene and conducted firefighting operations throughout the duration of the fire. (U.S. Marine Corps video by Sgt. Noah Martinez)
keywords: Marine Corps Base Camp Pendleton, Wildfire, Cal Fire, Fire, firefighter, Henderson Fire
